mapper.sql: release_id, tenant_id, rule_set_code, release_version, scene, snapshot_json, checksum, deleted, published_by, published_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.release_id, r.tenant_id, r.rule_set_code, r.release_version, r.scene, r.snapshot_json, r.checksum, r.deleted, r.published_by, r.published_at FROM sdk_spel_rule_release r INNER JOIN (SELECT rule_set_code, MAX(release_id) AS release_id FROM sdk_spel_rule_release WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scene = #{scene} GROUP BY rule_set_code) latest ON latest.release_id = r.release_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY r.rule_set_code
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(release_id), 0) FROM sdk_spel_rule_release WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scene = #{scene}
